title: Reversing the text is not reversing the path: a fixed-text measure without a zero, and an assembly-order comparison that vanishes identically
abstract: arXiv:2611.23049v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For an ensemble of trajectories the fluctuation theorems give the entropy production its meaning and zero. The same expression has recently been evaluated on one fixed text, $\Delta = [\log P(x) - \log P(\tilde x)]/L$ with $\tilde x$ the text in reversed order, read as an entropy production separating causally from arbitrarily ordered prose. A single text is neither a distribution nor a dynamics, and the texts at issue were produced by other models. No theorem fixes where the zero of a fixed-text quantity lies: the expression carries over from an ensemble, its zero does not.   We supply a zero from an exact antisymmetry. Scoring a text's $n$ sentences in all $n!$ orders, reversal carries $\pi$ to $\pi \circ \mathrm{rev}$, a measure-preserving involution, so $\Delta(\pi) = -\Delta(\pi \circ \mathrm{rev})$ identically and the values are centred at zero for any score. The authored arrangement's midrank is then unitless, bounded, and 0.50

translated_title: 逆转文本并非逆转路径：一个缺乏零点的固定文本度量，以及一个恒为零的组装顺序比较
translated_abstract: 对于轨迹系综而言，涨落定理赋予了熵产生以意义和零点。最近，同一个表达式被应用于单个固定文本，即 Δ = [log P(x) − log P(x̃)]/L，其中 x̃ 是顺序颠倒后的文本，并被解读为一种区分因果有序散文与任意排序散文的熵产生。然而，单个文本既不是分布也不是动力学，且所讨论的文本是由其他模型生成的。没有任何定理能确定固定文本量的零点位于何处：表达式可以从系综搬过来，但其零点却不能。我们通过一个精确的反对称性为其提供一个零点：在全部 n! 种排列顺序下对文本的 n 个句子进行评分时，逆转操作将排列 π 映为 π∘rev，这是一个保测度的对合变换，因此恒有 Δ(π) = −Δ(π∘rev)，且对于任何评分方法，数值都以零为中心。于是，作者排布的中位秩是无量纲的、有界的，且为 0.50。
tldr: 该论文指出单篇固定文本上的逆转比较度量（拟“熵产生”）缺乏由定理保证的零点，并利用在全部 n! 种句子排列下评分所得到的精确反对称性 Δ(π) = −Δ(π∘rev) 为其赋予零点，证明基于文本逆转的组装顺序比较恒为零，进而以作者排布的无量纲有界中位秩作为文本组织程度的替代度量。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that the fixed-text reversal measure lacks a theorem-guaranteed zero, and supplies one via the exact antisymmetry Δ(π) = −Δ(π∘rev) over all n! sentence orderings, showing that reversal-based assembly-order comparisons vanish identically and proposing the authored arrangement's unitless, bounded midrank as the alternative measure.
